release_notes:
v1.2.1 Release - Multi-Frame Group Calculations, Waveshare USB-CAN Engine, Clean Startup & UI Polishing.

Changes:
  - Group-Based Multi-Frame Calculations: Calculation groups (min, max, diff, avg, sum) dynamically aggregate signals across multiple frames (e.g. 16S cell voltages across 4 frames 0x2F1-0x2F4) on the final frame arrival without duplicate logging columns.
  - Waveshare USB-CAN Protocol Support: Live hardware streaming verified at 2,000,000 baud over virtual COM ports.
  - Robust Configuration Parsing: Excel loader defensively handles numeric booleans, type conversions, and cross-sheet signal name validation with zero crash dialogs on boot.
  - Startup & Theme Polish: Eliminated temporary 'Python' window flashes and dock promotion flicker on boot-up; perfected high-contrast vector icons and styling for Light, Dark, and System Default themes.
  - Menu De-duplication: Cleaned duplicate tool actions and streamlined navigation shortcuts.
